DECISION TO ASSIGN COUNSEL TOIBRAHIM BAZZYKAMARA
THEPRINCIPAL DEFENDER
CONSIDERING the Sta,tuteof the Residual SpecialCourt for Sierra Leoneand
in particular Article 23 thereof;
CONSIDERING the Rules of Procedure and Evidence as adopted by the
plenary meeting of the Residual Special Court as amended on the 30th
November 2018;
CONSIDERING the Directive onthe Assignmentof Counselasadopted bythe
Registrar on the 1St October 2003 and in particular Article 13thereof;
CONSIDERING that Mr. Ibrahim Bazzy Kamara a Special Court for Sierra
Leone Convict is presently serving a jail term in Mpanga Prison, Rwanda
pursuant to an Order ofthe SpecialCourt for Sierra Leone;
CONSIDERING that Ibrahim BazzyKamarahasinformed the ResidualSpecial
Court for Sierra Leone of his desire to appoint a Counselof his choice namely
Mr.Andrew Daniels from The Republicof Ghana;
CONSIDERINGthat Mr.Danielshasconsentedto representMr.Ibrahim Bazzy
Kamarapro bono byvirtue of anagreement between Mr.Kamaraandthe within
named Counsel to which the Residual SpecialCourt is not a party;
